result.title: Understanding Your Result
result.systolicExplain: Top number (Systolic): Pressure when your heart beats
result.diastolicExplain: Bottom number (Diastolic): Pressure when your heart rests between beats
result.whatItMeans: What does this mean for you?
result.whatItMeansBody: A single elevated reading does not mean you have a permanent condition. Blood pressure changes throughout the day. That is why a repeat confirmation reading and doctor consultation are needed.
result.guidelineDisclaimer: Clinical thresholds are to be confirmed by a clinician against the chosen guideline.
result.nextStep2: Our nurse coordinator assists you with scheduling.
result.nextStep3: A doctor reviews your health and agrees on a care plan with you.

ack.title: Acknowledge Your Result
ack.question: What is the primary next step after receiving this elevated reading?
ack.opt1: Ignore it because one reading does not matter
ack.opt2: Confirm with a repeat reading and discuss with a clinical provider
ack.opt3: Stop taking all prescribed medicines immediately
ack.successMessage: Thank you. Your acknowledgement has been recorded in your care file.

reading.title: Log Blood Pressure Cuff Reading
reading.subtitle: Use a validated upper arm cuff monitor
reading.cuffReminder: Rest quietly for 5 minutes before taking your measurement.

wearable.title: Continuous Health Signals
wearable.disclaimer: Wearable wristbands do not measure blood pressure. Review prompts only. Not clinically validated.
wearable.baselineShift: Signal deviation noticed. Clinical team notified for review.
